help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:330  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:331  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:332  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:333  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:334  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:335  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:336  * no run recorded at all, or nothing has run for longer than
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:337    4x `backup_interval_secs` (minimum 1 hour) -> exit 1. A dead timer
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:338    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:339    is the only thing that catches it.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:433  fields are tagged `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:434  / `{"kind":"not_applicable",…}` — an unknown is never serialised as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:435  `0`, `null` or a missing field. `claude.verdict.kind` is one of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:436  `unset_default` / `safe` / `small_value` / `parse_failed`;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:437  `reclaim.kind` is `ok` / `no_repo` / `no_key` / `open_failed`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:441  Prove the archive is intact. Three independently runnable levels:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:442  l1 = rustic structure check (cheap, no payload reads), l2 = rustic content
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:443  check (downloads and re-hashes every pack), l3 = reconcile against an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:444  expected manifest derived from the sealed staging tree (per session:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:445  shard count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:447  Which level(s) to run: `l1`, `l2`, `l3` or `all`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:450  Stage directory holding the sealed shard tree (required by l3 / all).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:453  Print full session ids in L3 rows (default: privacy-safe short ids).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:456  Machine partition (default: config `machine`, else this machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:457  identity; use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:460  Named destination from the config. Required once the config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:461  declares any destination; there is no default.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:464  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:467  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:470  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:473  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:476  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:480  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:481  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:482  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:483  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:484  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:485  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:486  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:487  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:488  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:489  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:490  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:492  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:493  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:496  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:499  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:502  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:505  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:506  repeatable. Default: every other destination in the config.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:509  Repository path override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:512  Masterkey file override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:515  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:518  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:521  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:524  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:525  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:526  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:527  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:531  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:532  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:533  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:534  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:535  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:536  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:537  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart. Use
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:538  `--cost` to see what a full-text pass over the current hits *would*
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:539  cost before asking for one; full-text matching is not implemented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:540  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:541  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:542  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:543  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:544  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:545  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:546  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:547  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:548  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:549  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:550  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:551  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:552  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:553  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:554  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:555  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:556  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:557  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:558  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:559  destination and answered for every session and nothing matched, `3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:560  could not finish — either reading it, or placing every session in time —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:561  so "nothing matched" is unproven. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:563  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:566  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  Emit one JSON object on stdout instead of the human report. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  three groups (matched / not matched / could not be placed) stay
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:571  separate fields, so a consumer cannot read an unknown as an absence.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:574  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:577  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:580  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:583  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:586  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:593  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:594  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:595  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:596  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:597  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:598  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:599  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:600  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:601  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:602  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:603  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:604  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:605  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:606  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:607  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:608  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:609  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:610  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:611  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:612  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:613  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:616  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:617  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:618  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:619  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:620  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:621  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:622  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:624  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:625  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:626  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:627  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:628  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:630  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:633  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:636  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:640  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:641  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:645  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:646  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:647  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:650  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:651  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:654  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:655  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:658  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:661  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:664  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:667  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:670  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:674  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:675  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:676  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:677  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:678  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:679  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:680  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:681  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:682  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:683  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:684  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:685  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:686  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:687  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:688  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:689  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:690  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:691  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:693  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:694  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  codes: 0 served the dashboard — even an archive that holds nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:697  which is served as an honest empty page rather than not starting; 3
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  could not finish reading (or no key), and is also the exit status after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699  serving an archive that could not be read in full; 2 is a usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:701  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:702  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:704  Consume ext inbox bundles into sealed staging shards.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:706  Reads complete `deepseek-<sessionId>.json` exports from `--inbox`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:707  (skipping `.part` files), archives each as one record in a sealed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:708  shard under `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<id>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`, and retires
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:709  the source file to `<inbox>/consumed/`. Idempotent by content: the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:710  bytes are never archived twice. Prints paths/counts/sha256 only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:712  Inbox directory holding the ext exports.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:715  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:718  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:719  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:720  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:723  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:727  Read every scanner session returned by `status` into our own stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:728  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:729  Harness sources are opened read-only. File-backed JSONL sources use a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:730  durable byte offset plus committed-prefix SHA-256; opencode SQLite
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:731  sessions use a durable logical high-water cursor. The cursor state lives
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:732  under chat-stasher's own data directory, not under any harness directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:733  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:734  Exit codes: 0 = every recognised session was archivable and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:735  collected; 3 = PARTIAL — the pass ran, but at least one harness
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:736  recognised sessions this build cannot archive (the `not archivable`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:737  line), so what was written is real but incomplete; 1 = the pass failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:738  (collect itself errored, or individual sources could not be read).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:740  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:743  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:745  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:748  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:751  Named destination from the config. Read state is kept per
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:752  destination, so a different destination is a different debt set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:755  Destination repository this pass collects *for*. Read state is kept
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  per destination, so a different value is a different debt set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759  Masterkey file override for the destination above.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:763  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764  This command never renames a harness-owned path.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:765  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:766  Gated by `data/harness-registry-v1.json` (`seal_policy` + `seal_source`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  + the platform cell's `confidence`): only a harness whose policy is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  `rename`, with an evidence `seal_source` line **and** a `source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:769  confirmed` platform cell may be renamed. Everything else (Codex = fd-holder,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770  opencode = sqlite, any unconfirmed harness) is refused with the active
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:771  file untouched — renaming an fd-holder silently drops its post-rename
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:772  data.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  Registry harness id that owns the active file (e.g. `claude-code`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777  Path of a file already inside --stage to seal. Paths outside the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:778  stage are rejected and left untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:781  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:784  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:785  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:786  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:789  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:792  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:797  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:798  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:799  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:800  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:801  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:802  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:803  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:804  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:805  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:806  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:807  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:808  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:809  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:810  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:813  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:818  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  Repository path override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:829  Masterkey file override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:832  Concurrency cap override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:835  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:838  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:842  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:844  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:845  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:848  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:849  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:850  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:851  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:852  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:853  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:854  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:857  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:858  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:859  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:862  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:873  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:876  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:879  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:887  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:890  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:896  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:908  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:924  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:930  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:932  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:933  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:934  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:938  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939  With `--rebuild --destination`, every archived session for that machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:940  is restored to a temporary child of `--stage`, the full index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  rebuilt, and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing snapshots
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:942  remain immutable. No snapshot is written until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:943  session restore finish, and only the named machine partition is pushed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  The rebuild is safe to re-run, but each run starts over and is not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:945  resumable. A same-machine snapshot found before publication restarts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:946  rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide that newer session.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:947  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:948  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:949  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:950  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:951  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:952  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:953  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:954  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:955  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:956  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:957  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:958  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:959  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:960  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:961  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:962  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:963  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:964  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:966  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:967  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:968  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:970  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:971  destination rebuild. Temporary restored shards are removed after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:972  the new snapshot is written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:975  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:976  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:977  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:980  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. The command has
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:981  always rebuilt rather than incrementally patched; this spelling is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:982  provided for repair workflows and makes that intent visible.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:985  Destination to rebuild from and append the repaired snapshot to.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:986  Requires `--rebuild`; either this or `--repo` must be named.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1005  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1007  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1008  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1009  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1010  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1011  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1012

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1016  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1017

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1051  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1052  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1053  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1054  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1055  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1056  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1057  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1058  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1059  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1060  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1061  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1062  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1063  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1064  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1065  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1066  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1067  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1068  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1069  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1070  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1071  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1072  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1073  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1084  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1085  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1086  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1087  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1088  reason in `error`.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1103  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1107  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1108  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1109  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1110  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1111  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1112  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1113  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1114  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1116  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1122  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1125  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1126  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1127  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1128  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1129  the next time a session is read.
